skill_name: Research and list the health benefits of eating apples.
workflow: Apples are a superfood with a wide range of health benefits. Eating apples can help boost your immune system, protect against cancer, and reduce your risk of stroke and heart disease. Apples are a source of dietary fiber and antioxidants, which can help keep your digestive system healthy. They are also a source of phytonutrients, which can help reduce inflammation in the body and reduce cholesterol levels.
